# Vittify

> A 100% private, offline-first personal finance companion and expense tracker for Android. Built from the ground up for convenience, speed, and daily ease of use.

## Overview
Vittify (package: `com.reddy.vittify`, website: https://vittify.in, repository: https://github.com/chappidiRushi/vittify) turns cryptic bank SMS notifications and physical paper receipts into a clean, actionable financial timeline with zero server dependencies.

- **Status**: Stable & Ready to Use. Pre-built APKs available on GitHub Releases. Community feedback and bug reports are welcomed on GitHub Issues.
- **License**: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)
- **Platform**: Android 8.0+ (API 26–36)
- **Architecture**: MVVM + Clean Architecture + UDF, Kotlin 2.3.0, Jetpack Compose BOM 2026.03.01, Material 3 Expressive.

## Core Philosophy & Design
- **Built for Convenience & Daily Ease of Use**: Tracking spending shouldn't feel like a chore. Automatic SMS parsing, 1-tap launcher widgets, on-device OCR, and natural English inputs make daily tracking effortless.
- **Privacy & Offline Sovereignty**: Zero cloud databases, zero telemetry, zero trackers, and zero third-party advertising. All bank SMS, account numbers, and receipts remain strictly on-device.

## Key Features

### 1. Intelligent On-Device SMS Parser
- Automatically recognizes and extracts transactions from 157+ banks across 24+ countries (India, US, UK, UAE, Nepal, Thailand, Kenya, Nigeria, Saudi Arabia, Germany, etc.).
- Read-only SMS inspection; message bodies are parsed locally in milliseconds and never uploaded anywhere.
- Auto-categorizes merchants, extracts account last-4 digits, balances, and handles debit/credit/transfer/investment types.

### 2. Receipt Scanning, On-Device OCR & AI Extraction
- **Google ML Kit OCR**: Snap physical receipts or invoices to extract merchant, total amount, taxes, and dates on-device without cloud latency.
- **Optional Gemini AI Extraction**: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) for structured breakdown of complex line items, taxes, discounts, and tips.
- **Split Transactions**: Easily split single receipts across multiple categories (e.g. groceries vs. household items).
- **Receipt & Document Attachments**: Attach bill photos directly to transaction records for warranty and audit storage.

### 3. Convenience First: Home Screen Widgets & Shortcuts
- **Home Screen Quick Add Widget**: Log cash spending, street food, or transit fares in two taps directly from the launcher.
- **Scan Receipt Launcher Widget**: Dedicated 1-tap shortcut to launch receipt scanning directly.
- **Plain-English Quick Add**: Type natural language sentences like "₹450 groceries at Blinkit via HDFC" to auto-fill transactions.
- **Subcategory Catalogue**: Rich built-in item catalogue providing instant autocomplete matching.

### 4. Smart UPI & Bank PDF Statement Parsing
- Directly import monthly UPI statements from Google Pay (GPay), PhonePe, Paytm, and standard bank PDF exports.
- Generate branded, publication-ready PDF statements with executive summaries and category distributions.

### 5. Serverless Couple / Partner P2P Sync
- Share and synchronize finances with a partner without storing data on any remote server.
- Uses encrypted peer-to-peer transport over Google Play Services Nearby Connections and WebRTC local mesh.
- Pair in 5 seconds via QR code; switch between "Both", "Me", and "Partner" spending views.

### 6. Optional Google Gemini AI (BYOK)
- 100% opt-in. Vittify is fully functional offline without AI.
- Connect your private Google Gemini API key directly (Gemini 2.5 Flash, 2.5 Pro, lightweight models).
- Offline token counter and configurable prompt templates.

### 7. Encrypted Multi-Cloud Backup & Restore
- Supports Google Drive, Nextcloud, and any custom WebDAV endpoint.
- Client-side AES-256 encryption using passphrase before upload; cloud providers only see opaque ciphertext.

### 8. Financial Intelligence & Budgets
- Category-level monthly budgets with adaptive daily allowance indicators.
- Subscription and recurring payment tracker with annualized forecasts.
- GitHub-style daily spending heatmaps and interactive bezier trend curves.
- Multi-currency support (INR, USD, AED, EUR, GBP, NPR, THB, and more) with live conversion approximations.
